source_text:
theorem kernel_necessity
    {Carrier : Type u}
    {Scope : Type v}
    {Value : Type w}
    (X : IncidenceSystem Carrier Scope Value)
    (hDeterminate : X.Determinate)
    (hNondegenerate : X.Nondegenerate) :
    exists K : Kernel X, K.ReferenceUnique ∧ K.Nontrivial := by
  let K := kernelOfIncidence X
  refine ⟨K, K.reference_unique_of_determinate hDeterminate, ?_⟩
  rcases hNondegenerate with ⟨carrier, scope, hNoIncidence⟩
  refine ⟨carrier, scope, ?_⟩
  apply (K.failure_iff carrier scope).2
  intro value hIncidence
  exact hNoIncidence ⟨value, hIncidence⟩

theorem determinateNondegenerateObjecthood
    {Carrier : Type u}
    {Scope : Type v}
    {Value : Type w}
    (X : IncidenceSystem Carrier Scope Value)
    (hDeterminate : X.Determinate)
    {endpoint : X.Locus}
    (reference : X.ReferenceAt endpoint)
    (hNondegenerate : X.Nondegenerate) :
    X.AdmissibleAt endpoint.1 endpoint.2 ∧
      (kernelOfIncidence X).StandingAt endpoint.1 endpoint.2 ∧
      (kernelOfIncidence X).ReferenceUnique ∧
      (kernelOfIncidence X).Nontrivial ∧
      Asymmetric (kernelOfIncidence X).StandingToFailure ∧
      exists boundary : X.Locus,
        (kernelOfIncidence X).FailureAt boundary.1 boundary.2 ∧
        (kernelOfIncidence X).StandingToFailure endpoint boundary ∧
        Not (Nonempty (X.Continuation endpoint boundary)) := by
  let K := kernelOfIncidence X
  have hAdmissible : X.AdmissibleAt endpoint.1 endpoint.2 :=
    X.admissibleAt_of_reference reference
  have hStanding : K.StandingAt endpoint.1 endpoint.2 :=
    (K.admissibleAt_iff_standingAt endpoint.1 endpoint.2).1 hAdmissible
  have hUnique : K.ReferenceUnique :=
    K.reference_unique_of_determinate hDeterminate
  rcases X.canonicalKernel_failure_of_nondegenerate hNondegenerate with
    ⟨boundary, hFailure⟩
  have hDirection : K.StandingToFailure endpoint boundary :=
    ⟨hStanding, hFailure⟩
  refine ⟨hAdmissible, hStanding, hUnique, ?_,
    K.standingToFailure_asymmetric, boundary, hFailure, hDirection, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨boundary.1, boundary.2, hFailure⟩
  · exact K.noContinuation_of_standingToFailure hDirection

end IncidenceSystem

    {Y : Type z} (f : X → Y)

theorem unique_factorization (observe : X → (q : Query) → Value q)
    {Y : Type z} (f : X → Y)
    (constant : ∀ x y, Equivalent observe x y → f x = f y) :
    ∃! reduced : CanonicalQuotient observe → Y,
      ∀ x, reduced (classify observe x) = f x := by
  refine ⟨descend observe f constant, fun _ => rfl, ?_⟩
  intro other commutes
  funext a
  exact Quotient.inductionOn a commutes

structure KGScalarSSQ1Witness (a : Parameters)
    (H : KGNRSpatialHilbert →ₗ.[ℂ] KGNRSpatialHilbert) (V : KGSpatialSpace → ℝ) where
  data : KGScalarDifferentialData
  response : 𝓢(KGSpatialSpace,ℂ) →L[ℂ] 𝓢(KGSpatialSpace,ℂ)
  response_data : ∀ f x,response f x = kgScalarJetResponse data f x
  complete_graph : ∀ f g,(f,g) ∈ H.graph ↔ ∀ test : 𝓢(KGSpatialSpace,ℂ),
    (g : KGSpatialDistribution) test = (f : KGSpatialDistribution) (response test)
  evolution : KGClosedScalarEvolution a H
  Q1_hilbert_internal : ∃ k : Momentum → ℝ,
    H.graph = (AASCSpatial.unitaryTransport (kgPhysicalSpatialUnitary a)
      (Multiplication.realMultiplication k)).graph
  Q2_dense_domain : Dense (H.domain : Set KGNRSpatialHilbert)
  Q3_self_adjoint : IsSelfAdjoint H
  Q4_linear : ∀ f g : H.domain,H (f+g) = H f + H g
  Q5_projective : ∀ (c : ℂ) (f : H.domain),H (c • f) = c • H f
  Q6_local : ∀ (f g : 𝓢(KGSpatialSpace,ℂ)) x,(f : KGSpatialSpace → ℂ) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] g → response f x = response g x
  Q7_euclidean :
    (∀ (R : KGSpatialSpace ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] KGSpatialSpace) f g,(f,g) ∈ H.graph →
      (kgNRSpatialRotation R f,kgNRSpatialRotation R g) ∈ H.graph) ∧
    (∀ (b : KGSpatialSpace) f g,(f,g) ∈ H.graph →
      (kgNRSpatialTranslation b f,kgNRSpatialTranslation b g) ∈ H.graph)
  Q8_order : ∀ f g x,KGScalarSameTwoJet f g x → response f x = response g x
  Q9_uniform_principal : ∃ c : ℝ,c ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ x i j,
    data.principal x i j = if i=j then (c : ℂ) else 0
  Q10_no_gauge : ∀ x i,data.first x i = 0
  Q11_scalar_fibre : Module.finrank ℂ ℂ = 1
  Q12_spatial_only : ∀ (f : ℝ → 𝓢(KGSpatialSpace,ℂ)) t x,
    response (f t) x = kgScalarJetResponse data (f t) x
  Q13_no_nonlinearity : ∀ (c : ℂ) (f g : 𝓢(KGSpatialSpace,ℂ)),response (c • f+g) = c • response f + response g
  Q14_closed_norm : ∀ t f,‖evolution.flow t f‖ = ‖f‖
  Q15_no_update : ∀ t,Function.Bijective (evolution.flow t)
  Q16_no_nonlocal : ∀ f g x,KGScalarSameTwoJet f g x → response f x = response g x
  Q17_maximal_full_space_domain : ∀ f,f ∈ H.domain ↔ ∃ g : KGNRSpatialHilbert,
    ∀ test : 𝓢(KGSpatialSpace,ℂ),
      (g : KGSpatialDistribution) test = (f : KGSpatialDistribution) (response test)
  Q18_potential_ledger : (∀ x,data.zeroth x = (V x : ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ f g,(f,g) ∈ (kgNRPotentialOperator V).graph ↔
      g =ᵐ[volume] (fun x => (V x : ℂ)*f x))
  Q19_nontrivial : ∀ c : ℂ,∃ f : H.domain,H f ≠ c • f.val

theorem original_total_action_implies_scalar_clock_matching
    (Sgrav : MetricSourceProbe Ω → ℝ)
    (regular : NativeActionFiniteParamDifferentiable Sgrav)
    (metricLF : ∀ (K : Compacts CoordinatePoint) (hK : (K : Set CoordinatePoint) ⊆ Ω),
      Continuous (nativeActionDirectional Sgrav ∘ TestFunction.ofSupportedIn hK))
    (g : MetricField) (hs : MetricFieldSymmetric g)
    (χ : CoordinatePoint → ℝ) (μ κ : ℝ) (hg : Continuous g)
    (hχ : ContDiff ℝ 2 χ) (hn : ∀ p ∈ Ω, (g p).det ≠ 0)
    (frames : ∀ p ∈ Ω, ∃ B : CoordinatePoint ≃L[ℝ] CoordinatePoint, LorentzFrameAt g p B)
    (E : MetricField) (symmetric : MetricFieldSymmetric E)
    (density_regular : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (sourceDensityCoordinates (raisedSourceTensorDensity g E) i) Ω)
    (geometric_variation : ∀ i (ψ : ScalarSourceProbe Ω),
      (-κ) * representedMetricSource (nativeTestActionFunctional Sgrav regular metricLF) i ψ =
        ∫ p, sourceDensityCoordinates (raisedSourceTensorDensity g E) i p * ψ p)
    (metric_equation : ∀ h : MetricSourceProbe Ω,
      nativeActionDirectional (fun k => Sgrav k + nativeScalarClockRelativeAction g χ μ k) h = 0) :
    ∀ p ∈ Ω, E p = (κ • scalarFieldStress g χ μ) p := by
  have balance := original_total_action_stationarity_source_balance Sgrav regular metricLF
    g hs χ μ hg hχ hn metric_equation
  have coordinates (i : Fin 10) : ∀ p ∈ Ω,
      sourceDensityCoordinates (raisedSourceTensorDensity g E) i p =
        κ * nativeClockSourceCoefficient g (nativeScalarClockGradient χ) χ μ i p := by
    have hc := native_scalar_clock_coefficients_continuousOn g χ μ hg hχ hn i
    have hf : ContinuousOn (fun p => sourceDensityCoordinates (raisedSourceTensorDensity g E) i p -
        κ * nativeClockSourceCoefficient g (nativeScalarClockGradient χ) χ μ i p) Ω :=
      (density_regular i).sub (continuousOn_const.mul hc)
    have hz := continuousOn_scalar_source_tests_separate Ω _ hf (by
      intro ψ
      have hE := native_locally_integrable_test_product _
        ((density_regular i).locallyIntegrableOn Ω.isOpen.measurableSet) ψ
      have hT := native_locally_integrable_test_product _
        (hc.locallyIntegrableOn Ω.isOpen.measurableSet) ψ
      simp_rw [sub_mul,mul_assoc]
      rw [integral_sub hE (hT.const_mul κ),integral_const_mul,
        ← geometric_variation,← native_clock_constructed_source_integral_components
          g (nativeScalarClockGradient χ) χ μ hg
          (native_scalar_clock_gradient_continuous χ hχ) hχ.continuous hn]
      have hb := balance i ψ
      change _ + representedMetricSource (nativeClockMetricLF g
        (nativeScalarClockGradient χ) χ μ hg (native_scalar_clock_gradient_continuous χ hχ)
        hχ.continuous hn) i ψ = 0 at hb
      linear_combination -κ * hb)
    intro p hp
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hz p hp)
  have hT : MetricFieldSymmetric (scalarFieldStress g χ μ) := by
    intro p a b
    simp only [scalarFieldStress,hs p a b]
    ring
  have hscaled : MetricFieldSymmetric (κ • scalarFieldStress g χ μ) := by
    intro p a b
    change κ * scalarFieldStress g χ μ p a b = κ * scalarFieldStress g χ μ p b a
    rw [hT p a b]
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨B,hB⟩ := frames p hp
  apply raised_source_tensor_density_point_injective g hs p
    (native_lorentz_frame_determinant_negative g p B hB) E (κ • scalarFieldStress g χ μ)
  have hrE := source_density_coordinates_recover _ (raised_source_tensor_density_symmetric g E symmetric)
  have hrT := source_density_coordinates_recover _ (raised_source_tensor_density_symmetric g _ hscaled)
  ext a b
  have he := congrArg (fun t : MetricField => t p a b) hrE
  have ht := congrArg (fun t : MetricField => t p a b) hrT
  dsimp only at he ht
  rw [← he,← ht,raised_source_tensor_density_smul]
  exact (coordinates _ p hp).trans (by
    rw [native_clock_coefficient_is_actual_raised_density g hs χ μ p B hB]
    rfl)
